author: Guerrilla Miniature Games
description:
We're back with The Indie Hour Episode Seventy-Six! This series focuses on games you may have never even heard of and gives us an inside look at the wider world of independantly published Tabletop Wargames of all genres.

Do you consider humans TOO PUNY? Have you ever dreampt of laying waste to casties, inns and taverns while you pummel your rivals to dust? Or are you just not into Giants and feel the need to drive them from their ancestral lands? Scal is a Dark Ages game st in a land where Giants and Humans clash in 6-10mm. Let's check it out!

Check out the rules HERE https://www.wargamevault.com//product/573726/scal?affiliate_id=210041
title: The GMG Indie Hour Ep 076 - Scal by Jack Edwards
